name: Kular
long_description:
Kular is an AI Lead Generator, generating leads for busy professionals and business owners and only charging for results. Today, Kular generates leads for over 1000 companies via email and LinkedIn. 

Kular is being built by a team of MIT, IIT, Cambridge and Oxford grads, backed by some of the best investors in the world, including Y-Combinator, Entrepreneur First, Acequia Capital and angel investors behind companies like Ironclad, OpenSea and Stripe.

founders.title: Founder
founders.founder_bio: Nelson is the cofounder of Kular and an entrepreneur by background, starting his first business during his last year studying law at Oxford University.

launches.title: Kular Website Visitors
launches.tagline: Never miss a sales opportunity again; turn anonymous website traffic into high-quality leads automatically.
launches.body:
**The Problem**

You wouldn’t leave potential customers sitting in your waiting room. So why would you leave them sitting on your website?

**The Solution**

Kular Website Visitors automatically identifies visitors to your website, researches them and, where appropriate, autonomously engages them via email. Now you can turn anonymous traffic into high-quality leads on autopilot. See the full launch video here: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=oj1rNG2j36Y

**Our Ask**\
Sign up here to receive your first 20 visitors for free: [web.kular.ai/onboarding/website](http://web.kular.ai/onboarding/website)

After the trial, we’re the only provider in the market to offer pay-as-you-go pricing ($0.30 per identified visitor, no minimum, no lock-in).

launches.body:

https://youtu.be/WKHBjLI14bw

**The problem**\
Outbound sales are increasingly crowded. Now more than ever, companies need to stand out from the crowd with a personal touch. This works for large enterprises, but small businesses don’t have the time or resources to meet the demands of modern outbound.

**The solution**\
Kular AI Voice Notes: you can now clone your own voice today to reach out to prospects in any language, anywhere in the world.

With just 15 seconds of set-up time and no upfront cost, you can use cutting-edge AI to generate leads and only charge for results. Kular makes it so easy that your grandparents can use AI voice at scale.

Only pay when you receive a lead ($250/lead, reduced to $150/lead for YC alumni/referrals).

launches.title: Kular - AI Lead Generator
launches.tagline: Kular generates leads for over 1000 companies and only charges for results
launches.body:
**TLDR;** Kular is an AI Lead Generator, delivering qualified sales leads and only charging for results ($250/reply or $375/booked meeting).

<https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=zDPTJJWWRkA>

**The problem:** Outbound can work for everyone, but it's hard for “normal” businesses without VC money and software margins.

* Every B2B business needs sales leads, and outbound sales is a very effective way to generate leads.
* Outbound requires a lot of upfront investment in time, skills, data and infrastructure.
* This works for VC backed software companies with money in the bank and high margins to invest in getting outbound working.
* There are 2 million “normal” B2B businesses in the US who can’t currently access outbound as a channel.

**The solution:** AI lead generator: generate sales qualified leads with the click of a button, only pay for the leads you receive.

* Kular makes outbound so easy your grandparents can run outbound campaigns at scale.
* Click 1 button in our web application, and Kular will take care of the entire process, including strategy, infrastructure and execution.
  * Strategy: Kular will read your website to understand who you want to target, and suggest messaging to reach them.
  * Infrastructure: Kular will set up and warm domains and mailboxes for you to send emails.
  * Execution: Kular will find the right contacts to reach out to, get their email addresses, and email the right person at the right time.
* Only pay when you receive a lead ($250/lead, reduced to $150/lead for YC alumni/referrals).

**Our ask:**

* Sign up here to receive a free lead: [**http://web.kular.ai/onboarding?utm_source=BF**](http://web.kular.ai/onboarding?utm_source=BF)
* We’ll be posting about the highs and lows of directly correlating our revenue with the results we deliver for customers. Follow our LinkedIn page to hear more: [**https://uk.linkedin.com/company/joinkular**](https://uk.linkedin.com/company/joinkular)
